cold-call.title: Cold Call
cold-call.description: Contact a new lead to secure a first meeting.
cold-call.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice cold calling. What's your sales challenge today?
objectives: Capture attention and establish credibility with the prospect
Build rapport and gather context about their current situation
Identify potential challenges or risks they may be facing
Secure agreement for a follow-up meeting or next conversation

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.description: Probe the client's situation to uncover needs and facts.
discovery.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice discovery conversations. What's your sales challenge today?
objectives: Understand the client's current financial situation and goals
Uncover underlying needs and pain points through probing questions
Identify decision-making criteria and timeline
Gather facts needed to propose appropriate solutions

competitive-proposal.title: Competitive Proposal
competitive-proposal.description: Present your solution and out-position rival products the client is weighing.
competitive-proposal.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice competitive proposals. What's your sales challenge today?
objectives: Present your solution with clear value propositions
Differentiate your offering from competitor alternatives
Address client concerns about competing products
Secure commitment to move forward with your proposal

objection-handling.title: Objection Handling Drill
objection-handling.description: Rapid-fire pushbacks on price, need, or timing and keep value anchored.
objection-handling.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice objection handling. What's your sales challenge today?
objectives: Actively listen to understand the root cause of objections
Respond with relevant value propositions and benefits
Overcome price, timing, and need-based concerns
Maintain client engagement and progress toward agreement

product-positioning.title: Product Positioning
product-positioning.description: Navigate objections while reinforcing your product's core value.
product-positioning.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice product positioning. What's your sales challenge today?
objectives: Present product features in terms of client-specific benefits
Position product advantages against market alternatives
Handle product-related objections and concerns
Create urgency and desire for the recommended solution

closing.title: Closing
closing.description: Confirm agreement and collect application details.
closing.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice closing techniques. What's your sales challenge today?
objectives: Summarize agreed-upon solutions and benefits
Confirm client commitment to move forward
Collect necessary application information and documentation
Schedule next steps and implementation timeline

review-renewal.title: Review / Renewal
review-renewal.description: Revisit current coverage to renew, tweak, or upsell.
review-renewal.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice renewal conversations. What's your sales challenge today?
objectives: Review current coverage and policy performance
Identify changes in client circumstances and needs
Present renewal options and potential enhancements
Secure renewal commitment or upsell opportunities

fna.title: Financial Needs Analysis
fna.description: Conduct comprehensive financial needs assessments to identify client protection, savings, and investment requirements.
fna.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice Financial Needs Analysis. What's your sales challenge today?
objectives: Introduction: Greet by name, state your advisor role and Manulife's credentials/CSR to establish credibility.
Build rapport & surface needs: Walk life stages, probe disruptions/dreams, run suitability questions, and quantify protection/health/education/retirement needs.
Closing (next steps): Send/confirm paperwork, schedule the follow-up, get consent to contact, capture referrals and invite feedback.

goalready.title: Product Pitch · Goal Ready
goalready.description: Practice presenting Manulife's GoalReady long-term savings and retirement planning product to entrepreneurs and self-employed individuals.
goalready.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice your GoalReady product pitch. What's your sales challenge today?
objectives: Greeting & Context: Welcome the client warmly, confirm this is a scheduled GoalReady pitch meeting, and build initial rapport.
Present GoalReady Features: Explain long-term savings structure, retirement benefits, guaranteed returns, education funding capabilities, and flexible premium payment options for variable income.
Handle Objections: Address concerns about premium affordability, retirement timing ('I have time later'), and 'need to think/consult family' using LAPR or 3F frameworks.
Close & Next Steps: Use proven closing techniques, ask for commitment, and guide toward specific next steps (application, follow-up meeting).

needs-analysis.title: Insurance Needs Analysis
needs-analysis.description: Analyze client risk profile and coverage requirements.
needs-analysis.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice insurance needs analysis. What's your sales challenge today?

policy-explanation.title: Policy Explanation
policy-explanation.description: Explain complex insurance terms and benefits clearly.
policy-explanation.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice policy explanations. What's your sales challenge today?

risk-assessment.title: Risk Assessment
risk-assessment.description: Evaluate and communicate potential risks and protection needs.
risk-assessment.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice risk assessment. What's your sales challenge today?

premium-discussion.title: Premium Discussion
premium-discussion.description: Handle pricing conversations and payment options.
premium-discussion.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice premium discussions. What's your sales challenge today?

policy-closing.title: Policy Closing
policy-closing.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice policy closing. What's your sales challenge today?

policy-renewal.title: Policy Renewal
policy-renewal.description: Review existing coverage and discuss renewal options.
policy-renewal.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice policy renewals. What's your sales challenge today?

solution-discovery.title: Solution Discovery
solution-discovery.description: Identify technical requirements and business challenges.
solution-discovery.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice solution discovery. What's your sales challenge today?

demo-presentation.title: Demo Presentation
demo-presentation.description: Showcase product features and technical capabilities.
demo-presentation.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice demo presentations. What's your sales challenge today?

technical-objections.title: Technical Objections
technical-objections.description: Address technical concerns and implementation questions.
technical-objections.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice handling technical objections. What's your sales challenge today?

pricing-negotiation.title: Pricing Negotiation
pricing-negotiation.description: Negotiate licensing, implementation, and ongoing costs.
pricing-negotiation.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice pricing negotiations. What's your sales challenge today?

contract-closing.title: Contract Closing
contract-closing.description: Finalize terms, conditions, and service agreements.
contract-closing.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice contract closing. What's your sales challenge today?

account-expansion.title: Account Expansion
account-expansion.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice account expansion. What's your sales challenge today?

general-sales.title: General Sales Practice
general-sales.description: Practice general sales conversations and techniques.
general-sales.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice general sales techniques. What's your sales challenge today?

discovery-call-meddpicc.title: Discovery Call
discovery-call-meddpicc.description: Uncover client pain points, needs, and budget using MEDDPICC methodology.
discovery-call-meddpicc.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice a Discovery Call focused on understanding your prospect's business needs, challenges, and decision-making process. What's your approach?
objectives: Identify and quantify business metrics and key performance indicators
Understand economic impact and budget considerations
Map decision-making process and identify key stakeholders
Uncover pain points, implications, and critical business needs

deal-closure.title: Deal Closure
deal-closure.description: Negotiate with the prospect to align on key commercial details and close the deal.
deal-closure.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice Deal Closure where we'll focus on late-stage negotiations, aligning on commercial terms, and driving the deal to signature using MEDDPICC methodology. How are you approaching this final stage?
objectives: Confirm agreed metrics and ROI documentation in the business case
Secure final sign-off from economic buyer on pricing and terms
Navigate paper process and address legal/compliance requirements
Drive urgency while maintaining value focus to achieve signature

telesales.title: Tele Sales
telesales.description: Make effective telemarketing calls to generate leads and close sales remotely.
telesales.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice telesales calls. What's your telemarketing challenge today?
objectives: Build rapport and position the product as relevant to client's needs
Handle objections and communicate value clearly
Close the sale—or exit the call professionally if the client is not interested

agency-sales.title: Agency Sales
agency-sales.description: Establish credibility and drive growth through consultative selling.
agency-sales.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice agency sales calls. What's your agency sales challenge today?
objectives: Build rapport and position the product as relevant to client's needs
Handle objections and communicate value clearly
Close the sale—or exit the call professionally if the client is not interested

grab-mex.title: Budget Constraint Handling
grab-mex.description: Practice handling merchant budget constraints and P&L concerns while driving campaign participation.
grab-mex.initialMessage: Welcome to Budget Constraint Handling training! Let's practice addressing merchant P&L concerns and budget limitations while positioning campaign value. How can we help overcome their funding objections today?
objectives: Use LAER framework to handle objections
Overcome merchant budget constraints and P&L concerns by demonstrating campaign ROI
Position the $145,000 media value proposition and cost-benefit analysis
Apply MEDDPICC methodology to qualify opportunities and close campaign deals

bbl-client-upgrade.title: Client Upgrade (in-person meeting)
bbl-client-upgrade.description: Contact an existing client to upgrade them to Wealth services.
bbl-client-upgrade.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice client upgrade conversations. What's your advisory challenge today?
objectives: Welcome the client to Wealth and note any recent life or career changes.
Present key Wealth services and benefits that fit the client's goals.
Explore the client's profile and priorities to capture essential updates.
Secure agreement for a follow-up investment advisory session.

bbl-goal-planning.title: Goal Planning (in-person meeting)
bbl-goal-planning.description: Define, size, and plan financial goals with tailored solutions and next steps.
bbl-goal-planning.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice goal planning sessions. What's your advisory challenge today?
objectives: Identify and clarify the client's key financial goals and priorities.
Quantify timelines, amounts, and risk tolerance for each goal.
Present tailored solutions that align with their objectives.
Secure commitment to proceed with goal-based planning services.

bbl-client-revival.title: Client Revival (in-person meeting)
bbl-client-revival.description: Reconnect with inactive clients and spark re-engagement.
bbl-client-revival.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice client revival conversations. What's your advisory challenge today?
objectives: Re-establish the relationship and acknowledge recent inactivity or balance thresholds
Identify key reasons for inactivity and barriers to re-engagement
Explore current priorities and map a clear re-engagement path
Encourage an immediate step and secure the next touchpoint

bbl-portfolio-review.title: Portfolio Review (in-person meeting)
bbl-portfolio-review.description: Review portfolio performance, discuss market impact, propose adjustments, and confirm next steps.
bbl-portfolio-review.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice portfolio review conversations. What's your advisory challenge today?
objectives: Open the meeting with a warm welcome and recap of recent life or financial updates.
Introduce the reason for the portfolio review, linking it to market movements or personal milestones.
Review current portfolio performance and identify key gaps or imbalances.
Recommend tailored rebalancing or top-up solutions aligned to his goals and risk appetite, prioritizing proposing top-up solutions first.
Confirm next steps, secure agreement to proceed, and schedule a follow-up review with regards to the portfolio.

hsbc-client-onboarding.title: Client Onboarding
hsbc-client-onboarding.description: Introducing HSBC & Wealth to New to Bank (NTB) clients
hsbc-client-onboarding.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice client onboarding conversations. What's your advisory challenge today?
objectives: Welcome the client and establish rapport while introducing the bank's wealth management relationship model.
Introduce the bank's wealth proposition in a way that highlights differentiation and alignment with client's priorities.
Understand the client's financial profile, risk appetite, and onboarding requirements.
Guide the client toward first engagement in wealth products and establish the relationship rhythm.
Set up an in-person meeting to discuss HSBC Wealth's offerings in further detail.

hsbc-client-upgrade.title: New to Wealth
hsbc-client-upgrade.description: Contact an existing client to initiate a wealth journey with HSBC
hsbc-client-upgrade.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice client upgrade conversations. What's your advisory challenge today?
objectives: Welcome the client to Wealth and note any recent life or career changes.
Present key Wealth services and benefits that fit the client's goals.
Explore the client's profile and priorities to capture essential updates.
Secure agreement for a follow-up investment advisory session.
Set up an in-person meeting to discuss HSBC Wealth's offerings in further detail.

hsbc-goal-planning.title: Goal Planning
hsbc-goal-planning.description: Define, size, and plan financial goals with tailored solutions and next steps.
hsbc-goal-planning.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice goal planning sessions. What's your advisory challenge today?
objectives: Identify and clarify the client's key financial goals and priorities.
Quantify timelines, amounts, and risk tolerance for each goal.
Present tailored solutions that align with their objectives.
Secure commitment to proceed with goal-based planning services.

hsbc-client-revival.title: Client Revival
hsbc-client-revival.description: Reconnect with inactive clients and spark re-engagement.
hsbc-client-revival.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice client revival conversations. What's your advisory challenge today?
objectives: Re-establish the relationship and acknowledge recent inactivity or balance thresholds
Identify key reasons for inactivity and barriers to re-engagement
Explore current priorities and map a clear re-engagement path
Encourage an immediate step and secure the next touchpoint

hsbc-portfolio-review.title: Portfolio Review
hsbc-portfolio-review.description: Review portfolio performance, discuss market impact, propose adjustments, and confirm next steps.
hsbc-portfolio-review.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice portfolio review conversations. What's your advisory challenge today?
objectives: Open the call with a warm welcome and recap of recent life or financial updates.
Introduce the reason for the portfolio review, linking it to market movements or personal milestones.
Review current portfolio performance and identify key gaps or imbalances.
Recommend tailored rebalancing or top-up solutions aligned to his goals and risk appetite.
Confirm next steps, secure agreement to proceed, and schedule a follow-up review.

mtl-prospect-practice.title: Pitch Mastery
mtl-prospect-practice.description: Roles reversed: You play the prospect while observing a top-performing insurance agent conduct needs discovery and product explanation
mtl-prospect-practice.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice being a prospect. What's your challenge today?
objectives: Express your financial goals and priorities clearly as a realistic prospect
Ask meaningful questions a real prospect would ask about savings and investment options
Respond naturally to the agent's discovery questions and product explanations
Show realistic progression in your thinking as concerns are addressed
Complete needs discovery and product explanation in one conversation

axa-ph-unit-manager-recruitment.title: Unit Manager Recruitment
axa-ph-unit-manager-recruitment.description: Recruit new prospects who showed interest in the financial advising opportunity but are now unsure about taking the next step
axa-ph-unit-manager-recruitment.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice unit manager recruitment. What's your recruitment challenge today?
objectives: Make the role relatable by showing how their daily strengths (managing schedule, budgeting, planning, communication) are the same skills used in financial advising
Address time concerns by explaining how the role is flexible and can be done in quiet pockets of time
Reassure them that they can start at their own pace and the training will guide them step by step
Help them feel more confident and encourage them to attend the training session

axa-ph-financial-needs-analysis.title: Financial Needs Analysis
axa-ph-financial-needs-analysis.description: Guide a first-time client through a simple, low-commitment financial needs discussion while addressing concerns about affordability, flexibility, and early access to funds
axa-ph-financial-needs-analysis.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice financial needs analysis. What's your sales challenge today?
objectives: Build rapport with a first-time client
Conduct fact-finding on income, lifestyle, and future financial goals
Present a simple, affordable starter solution with guaranteed returns
Address concerns about commitment, flexibility, and early access to funds

axa-ph-general-objection-handling.title: Objection Handling
axa-ph-general-objection-handling.description: Handle common objections about education funding and family protection, including concerns like no money, no need, no hurry, no time and not in the market
axa-ph-general-objection-handling.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice handling objections. What objection would you like to work on?
objectives: Build rapport and trust with the client
Address concerns about payment flexibility and affordability
Explain benefits compared to alternatives like bank savings
Handle objections about early withdrawal and guarantees
Guide the conversation toward next steps

kt-axa-agent-recruitment.title: Recruitment of Prospective Agents
kt-axa-agent-recruitment.description: Recruit prospects by exploring their goals and challenges, presenting the insurance agent career opportunity, and guiding them to register for the company's career opportunity seminar.
kt-axa-agent-recruitment.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice agent recruitment. What's your recruitment challenge today?
objectives: Build rapport with prospects
Conduct fact-finding on income, lifestyle, and challenges faced in current job
Present the career of an insurance agent as a solution highlighting job details and growth opportunities to address their concerns
Handle objections related to job security, income, flexibility and support from supervisors/company
Close the prospect by guiding them to register for the company's career opportunity seminar (BOP)

kt-axa-fna-product-pitch.title: FNA & Product Pitch
kt-axa-fna-product-pitch.description: Explore the client's financial needs and propose Life Ready with CI 123 Critical Illness Rider to address their coverage needs, including protection against critical illnesses.
kt-axa-fna-product-pitch.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice Financial Needs Analysis and product pitching. What's your sales challenge today?
objectives: Build rapport with the prospect who reached out via Facebook showing interest in insurance
Conduct thorough fact-finding on age, occupation, income, financial goals, family situation, and existing coverage
Present Life Ready whole life insurance with tax deduction benefits tailored to their situation
Introduce CI 123 Critical Illness Rider covering 123 diseases with lump sum payment benefit
Handle objections about premium cost, existing coverage, and comparison with other products
Close by securing agreement or scheduling a follow-up meeting

kt-axa-wealthplus-close-call.title: WealthPlus Ready Follow Up Call
kt-axa-wealthplus-close-call.description: Follow up with a high-value prospect previously introduced to WealthPlus Ready 90/8 to position it as a legacy planning tool, address sophisticated objections, and close the sale.
kt-axa-wealthplus-close-call.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice closing a WealthPlus Ready 90/8 sale with a high-value prospect. What's your sales challenge today?
objectives: Build rapport and relationship with the high-value prospect
Conduct fact-finding on financial situation, family structure, retirement goals, and legacy planning needs
Position WealthPlus Ready 90/8 as a legacy planning and wealth transfer solution with maturity benefit
Demonstrate tax benefits and estate planning advantages (10% annual cash return, 8-year premium payment, coverage to age 90, escalating death benefit 100%-800%)
Handle sophisticated objections about price, product comparison, IRR, and fit with overall wealth strategy
Close by guiding the prospect to complete the application

prudential-ph-appointment-setting.title: Appointment Setting
prudential-ph-appointment-setting.description: Touch base with a prospect, build rapport, and set an appointment to explore more on their financial goals and objectives.
prudential-ph-appointment-setting.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice cold-call appointment setting. What's your sales challenge today?
objectives: Introduce yourself and Pru Life UK clearly, and gain permission to continue
Deliver a compelling value proposition tied to the prospect's life stage
Handle objections with empathy and persistence
Secure agreement for a follow-up meeting

prudential-ph-fact-finding.title: Product Pitch (in-person meeting)
prudential-ph-fact-finding.description: Meet a prospect face-to-face for a prescheduled appointment, build rapport through natural conversation, conduct fact-finding using SPIN methodology, and present the Pru Life UK solution.
prudential-ph-fact-finding.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice an in-person fact-finding and product pitch meeting. What's your sales challenge today?
objectives: Greet the prospect warmly and build rapport through natural small talk before transitioning to business
Use SPIN questions to uncover prospect needs and priorities
Select the most appropriate Pru Life UK product based on prospect profile and needs
Present product features clearly and connect benefits to the prospect's situation
Handle objections with empathy and specificity

great-eastern-fact-find.title: Fact Finding (Stage 1)
great-eastern-fact-find.description: Conduct a financial need analysis with a cold prospect to collect financial details, clarify goals, timeframes and risk comfort.
great-eastern-fact-find.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice fact finding. What's your sales challenge today?
objectives: Build rapport with the client
Practice asking questions to identify the client's real needs
Handle objections relating to trust, company preference, and insurance perception
Follow market conduct principles in providing suitable recommendations

great-eastern-product-pitch.title: Product Pitch (Stage 2)
great-eastern-product-pitch.description: (Please attempt after completing Stage 1) Explore the client's financial needs and propose Great Wealth Advantage 4 to address their coverage needs.
great-eastern-product-pitch.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice product pitch with Great Wealth Advantage 4. What's your sales challenge today?
objectives: Build rapport with the client
Practice asking questions to identify the client's real needs
Present the product clearly and completely
Handle objections related to pricing, coverage and comparative prices
Follow market conduct principles in providing suitable recommendations

great-eastern-post-sales.title: Post Sale Service (Stage 3)
great-eastern-post-sales.description: (Please attempt after completing Stage 1 & Stage 2) Address client concerns about market conditions and sub-fund performance one year after purchasing Great Wealth Advantage 4
great-eastern-post-sales.initialMessage: Welcome! Let's practice post sale service. What's your sales challenge today?
objectives: Build rapport with the client
Address worries about market volatility and product performance
Reassure on long-term nature, risk profile and dollar cost averaging
Handle objections about withdrawal and maintain trust

assessment.title: Roleplay Assessment
assessment.salesTechniqueDescription: Measures the ability to follow set framework to drive a successful conversation.
assessment.productKnowledgeDescription: Measures the ability to accurately convey product features, benefits, and key details.
assessment.technicalKnowledgeDescription: Measures the ability to accurately convey product features, benefits, and key details.
assessment.advisoryTechniqueDescription: Measures the ability to use advisory techniques to drive a successful conversation.
assessment.processAdherenceDescription: Measures how well company best-practice processes are followed to drive a successful conversation.
assessment.communicationAndPresenceDescription: Measures how well communication and presence are used to drive a successful conversation.
assessment.relationshipManagementDescription: Measures the ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.
assessment.mandatoryFailed: Standing unavailable: Mandatory criteria not met.
assessment.msigNextStepsTitle: To progress your standing, focus on:
assessment.msigMandatoryNotMetSummary: Your standing isn't available because you missed a mandatory criteria, which requires full adherence. Review your performance in other areas to see what went well, and make sure to complete all steps next time to receive your standing.

prudentialMandatoryNotMet.summary: Mandatory criteria not met. Please complete client verification before proceeding.
prudentialMandatoryNotMet.suggestedNextStep: Complete client verification requirements and retry the assessment.
